note: Coordinates are [lon, lat] WGS84. earliest = earliest departure, latest = latest arrival, local CEST on the heat day. Places follow walk/routes.py (T03 test pairs) plus Plac Zamkowy.

trips.name: Plac Zbawiciela → Uniwersytet (Krakowskie Przedmieście)
trips.reason: Midday peak on the 2.5 km north-south axis: the Marszałkowska canyon is sunlit at noon, tree-lined side streets and AC trams 4/15/18/35 are the alternatives.

trips.name: Dworzec Centralny → Łazienki main gate (Al. Ujazdowskie)
trips.reason: Afternoon heat where trees matter most: Al. Ujazdowskie has double tree rows that a building-only shade model cannot see; trams on Al. Jerozolimskie and AC buses on the Royal Route can cover part of it.

trips.name: Rondo Dmowskiego → Plac Trzech Krzyży
trips.reason: Low western sun (15° at 19:00) along the east-west Al. Jerozolimskie / Nowy Świat axis: long shadows, including far casters (Śródmieście towers), decide which side of the street is cool.

trips.name: Centrum Nauki Kopernik → Hala Mirowska
trips.reason: Longest cross-district trip (2.6 km, 40+ min on foot for the persona) against the afternoon sun: an AC bus or tram leg via Świętokrzyska / Al. Solidarności should beat any walk on dose.

trips.name: Plac Zamkowy → Plac Zbawiciela (whole day window)
trips.reason: 3.3 km along the Royal Route with AC buses (116/128/180/222 on Krakowskie Przedmieście and Nowy Świat) and a 10-hour window: shows the planner choosing when to leave, not only which way.
